title: Mind as Information Horizon: From Primordial Difference to Expertise Formation on the Discrete Causal Graph

equations.label: P3
equations.section: 2.2 The Three Postulates and the Telegraph Equation
equations.meaning: Postulate 3 (Finite Propagation Speed, Ax): influence propagates at a finite speed v derived from diffusion coefficient D and retained-efficacy timescale τ_c; no infinite-speed propagation is admitted.

equations.label: MQ.08
equations.section: 2.2 The Three Postulates and the Telegraph Equation
equations.meaning: The 'Mother Equation': from Postulates P1–P3 on a finite discrete graph with normalized restricted Laplacian L_R, this telegraph-like recurrence (damping coefficient γ, diffusion coefficient D_s, step size Δθ) is the unique minimal dynamics governing all structural persistence and decay; it is forced, not chosen (Th).

equations.label: Th-5
equations.section: 2.3 Eigenmodes, Decay, and the Emergence of Matter
equations.meaning: Impermanence Theorem: every eigenmode of L_R decays; decay rates differ but decay is universal — no structure persists forever.

equations.text: B[n] → H_body[n] → N[n] → S[n] ↔ A[n] → π[n] → U[n] → B[n+1]
equations.meaning: The Causal Body Framework (CBF): the complete causal chain through which a living agent (world-state B, body H_body, nervous system N, sensory interface S, internal agency state A, action policy π, executed output U) interacts with the world.
Discrete update of body state as a function of the world-state and prior body state.
Discrete update of the sensory interface.
Discrete update of the internal agency state, occurring strictly brain-internally.

equations.text: π[n+1] ∈ arg min_{π∈Π_feas} L_sel(S, H_body, π)
equations.meaning: Action-policy selection minimizes a selection loss over the feasible policy set.
Executed output is the execution of the selected policy.
World-state update as a function of prior world-state and the agent's executed output, closing the causal loop.
Minimal coupling equation (Dr): brain-body dynamics F plus a coupling term from the mind-core H.
Minimal coupling equation (Dr): mind-core persistence mechanics G plus a coupling term from the brain-body B.
Experience E is the resultant function R generated by the active coupling of brain-body and mind-core — experience is not identical to either component alone (Core Result, Dr).

equations.text: ε_tot = ε_clock + ε_cross + ε_sel + ε_map + ε_self
equations.meaning: Structural Error (Th): total observation error decomposes into clock error, cross-event mismatch, selection error, mapping/translation error, and self-model error (Th-PSA); this decomposition is a structural theorem derived from P1–P3, not an engineering limitation.

equations.text: Knowing = Coupled System + Selection + Retention + Model + Error + Correction
equations.meaning: Compressed formula for a knower: a coupled brain–mind-core system capable of stably sustaining model-comparison-correction loops under world-resistance.
Knowledge (Df) formalized as a triple: trace residue Tr_A, coherent usable structure Str_A, and generative capacity Cap_A.

equations.text: LegitKnow ⇔ Know_A ∧ Grounded ∧ Q_auth ≥ θ_Q ∧ N_know ≥ θ_N
equations.meaning: The Legitimacy Gate (Th): a knowledge event counts as legitimate knowledge only if it occurred, is grounded (answerable to world-resistance), meets a route-independent authentication threshold θ_Q, and meets a minimum count threshold θ_N of knowledge events for the domain — excluding echo-chamber and single-source outputs.
